title: Wojciech Siudmak, Energy, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description The “Energy” coin refers to one of Wojciech Siudmak’s most recognizable works. The reverse features a reproduction of the artist’s painting with a repeated detail from the composition — a dynamic human silhouette surrounded by light and space, symbolizing movement, growth, and creative force. The obverse is adorned with the “Guardian of the Desert,” faithfully transferred from the original. We offer the viewer what is most precious in art besides craftsmanship — something AI will not easily master, such as our imagination and our unique artistic trace… what I would call our brilliant lack of perfection, even a certain brilliant inelegance. Wojciech Siudmak
